major_reagents.name: Cell Enzyme Cocktail and lysis reagents

transitions.operation_detail: In-droplet cell lysis releases mRNA and bead oligos; cellular mRNA is captured by the bead poly(T) capture oligo and first-strand cDNA synthesis extends that oligo, transferring the bead barcode and UMI onto the cDNA (in-droplet program, Table 20).

major_reagents.name: 3' Enzyme Mix (legacy: RNase H and DNA polymerase I)

transitions.operation_detail: In-droplet second-strand cDNA synthesis converts the mRNA:cDNA hybrid into barcoded double-stranded cDNA. Droplet disruption is folded into this transition.
In-droplet polymerase extension of both recessed 3' ends of the annealed DO-A/DO-B pair produces a full-length double-stranded DO dimer that records which beads shared a droplet.

major_reagents.name: purification beads
major_reagents.role: separation of bead-bound cDNA and supernatant DO dimers

transitions.operation_detail: After droplet disruption, SPRI purification retains the cDNA in the bead-bound fraction while DO dimers remain in the supernatant; the two fractions are purified separately before library preparation.

A Tn5 transposome loaded with the s7-ME oligo as a homodimer fragments the double-stranded cDNA and transfers s7-ME to the 5' ends; gap fill extends the barcoded top strand across the Mosaic End. Three products form; middle fragments carrying s7 at both ends and 5'-end fragments are not amplifiable (semi-suppressive PCR), so only the 3'-end product carrying the bead handle is carried forward. Tagmentation is performed on the cDNA fraction only.

major_reagents.name: ddSEQ Single-Cell 3' RNA-Seq Dual Index Kit, cDNA Index Plate

transitions.operation_detail: Indexing PCR with the cDNA index plate adds P5 plus the i5 index and the full TruSeq Read 1 site at one end and the i7 index plus P7 at the s7 end, completing the dual-indexed cDNA library; cycle number follows Table 28. Library purifications, pooling and quantification are folded in.

major_reagents.name: ddSEQ Single-Cell 3' RNA-Seq Dual Index Kit, DO Index Plate

transitions.operation_detail: Parallel indexing PCR with the DO index plate (3 cycles at 50 C annealing then 13 cycles at 65 C, Table 30) adds P5 plus i5 at one end and the TruSeq Read 2 site plus i7 and P7 at the other. Products carrying P5 at both ends or P7 at both ends are not sequenceable and are not modeled as separate states. The same UDI is used as for the matching cDNA library.
